title: Ted Lasso Renewed for Season 5 at Apple TV
excerpt:
Apple TV has ordered another season of its Emmy-winning comedy.
The returning ensemble and premiere date have not been finalized.
body_md:
Ted Lasso remains a major title for Apple TV following a fourth season that concluded in early October 2026. The latest chapter introduced a new direction for the football comedy by placing greater emphasis on AFC Richmond's women's team.

According to Nielsen figures cited in the report, the fourth season spent 12 weeks in the streaming top ten and accumulated approximately 9.8 billion viewing minutes during that period. The metric represents aggregate viewing time rather than a count of individual viewers.

Season four spoilers follow. Jason Sudeikis's Ted returned to London to coach the women's team, but the finale saw him step down as head coach and become an assistant, allowing Alice, played by Tanya Reynolds, to take charge.

Rebecca, played by Hannah Waddingham, successfully defended her ownership of the club. Brett Goldstein's Roy took charge at Chelsea while preparing for parenthood with Keeley, played by Juno Temple. These developments offer several possible directions for future episodes.

Apple TV has not finalized which members of the ensemble will return, and a premiere date has not been announced. The renewal confirms the continuation of the series, but the precise creative direction of its fifth season remains open.
